doc.title: Rick Margitza interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, November 22, 2024

title: Thanks and goodbyes
summary: Closing thanks, Zoom chatter, payment and parting remarks.

story.theme_name: Thanks and goodbyes: closing the interview
story.community_name: Closing thanks and goodbyes at the end of the interview

blocks.x: Well this has been a fascinating conversation and I want to thank you for your time. And I hope that people after watching it go check out your music. And thank you.

My pleasure. You know there’s certain people you kind of just start talking to and it just feels natural so I really appreciate you. Thank you for inviting me and I’m glad to be part of the lineage of the show.
All right. I’m going to end this and we’ll just say good-bye.
Yeah. Okay we are — oops, are you still there?

Okay. We stopped recording. They keep updating Zoom and the little things you’re used to doing are like oh no they’ve changed. I have a theory about things like this, in all walks of life, things keep getting improved until they don’t work anymore.
That’s very astute and it’s borne out in a lot of different areas.
All right. So you can check, you’re able to check obviously your bank statements and let me know that this thing arrives, I hope soon. And —
Yeah if I don’t see it in a couple of weeks then I’ll just check in with you.
Oh yeah. I’m pretty sure it’ll show up before that. If you ever get back in the States and you’re going through Central New York you let us know.
Absolutely. It’d be nice to meet in person for sure.
So have a great Thanksgiving and Christmas and all that stuff and hopefully we’ll cross paths again at some point.
All right thanks Buddy. Take care.
Thank you, bye. © Fillius Jazz Archive -19-
